title: Data Readiness
seo: AI data readiness review for your business
meta: A review of whether your files, products and customer data are tidy enough to use with AI. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Data readiness review before you use AI
overview: AI is only as good as the information you give it. We look at the data you plan to use, such as product lists, customer records, help articles and spreadsheets, and check for gaps, duplicates, mixed formats and outdated entries. You receive a plain report that rates each source, shows examples of problems and lists the cleanup steps in order, so you fix the biggest issues first.

pkgs.blurb: A check of one data source with the biggest problems listed.
Several sources rated, with a cleanup plan in order.
A thorough review with a sample cleanup and privacy notes.

faq: What kind of data can you review?
Spreadsheets, CSV exports, product catalogs, CRM exports and help center articles. Send them as files or a read-only link, and remove anything you do not want us to see.
Do you need access to personal customer data?
Not necessarily. We can work from a sample with names and emails removed. If we do see personal data, we use it only for the review and delete it afterwards.
Will you fix the problems you find?
The review lists what to fix. The top package includes a sample cleanup to show the method. Full cleanup can be quoted separately once you know the size of the job.
How do you decide if data is ready?
By checking completeness, consistency, duplicates, freshness and clear labels. We explain each rating in plain words and show the rows that caused it.
